name: Production Cost Summary
query:
SELECT
    pp.name AS "Production Plan ID:Link/Production Plan:120",
    ppi.item_code AS "Finished Item:Link/Item:120",
    ppi.planned_qty AS "Production Quantity:Float:100",
    ppi.stock_uom AS "UOM:Link/UOM:100",
    bei.item_code AS "Exploded Component:Link/Item:120",
    (bei.stock_qty * ppi.planned_qty/bom.quantity) AS "Total Required Exploded Quantity:Float:150",
    bei.stock_uom AS "UOM:Link/UOM:100",
    (bei.rate) AS "Est. Cost Per Unit of Component:Float:180",
    (bei.stock_qty * ppi.planned_qty/bom.quantity * bei.rate) AS "Total Est. Cost for Component:Float:200"
FROM
    `tabProduction Plan` pp
JOIN
    `tabProduction Plan Item` ppi ON ppi.parent = pp.name
JOIN
    `tabBOM` bom ON bom.item = ppi.item_code AND bom.name = ppi.bom_no
JOIN
    `tabBOM Explosion Item` bei ON bei.parent = bom.name
WHERE
    pp.docstatus = 1
    AND pp.name = %(production_plan_id)s
ORDER BY
    pp.name, ppi.item_code, bei.item_code;
